name: iPOSpays Gateways WC
author: iPOSPays

sections.description:
A powerful WooCommerce gateway plugin that enables you to accept major credit cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay, ACH, and alternative payment methods with ease.

Supported Payment Methods in Redirect

  • Credit/Debit Cards
  • Google Pay
  • Apple Pay
  • Bank (ACH)
  • Alternative Payments

To use Google Pay, visit the site using a supported browser like Chrome.
To use Apple Pay, visit the site using an iOS device.

Supported Payment Methods in Embedded Method

  • Credit/Debit Cards only
  • Google Pay
  • Apple Pay
  • Bank (ACH)

Other payment methods for the embedded option will be added shortly.

Visit our demo site to see all the payment methods in action

Demo Site

To use Google Pay, visit the site using a supported browser like Chrome. To use Apple Pay, visit the site using an iOS device.

Google Pay Support

iPOSpays includes Google Pay support, allowing customers to quickly and securely pay using payment details saved to their Google Account. With Google Pay, checkout is as easy as a single tap on mobile and desktop devices.

  • Google Pay: For more information regarding data handling and user privacy, please refer to the following:
    • Google Pay Privacy Policy
    • Google Pay Terms of Service

Apple Pay Support

iPOSpays includes Apple Pay enabling customers to make fast and secure payments using their Apple devices. Merchants can integrate Apple Pay on their websites or apps to provide a seamless checkout experience.

To enable Apple Pay, the merchant must have an Apple Developer Account to register their domain for Apple Pay transactions

  • Apple Pay: For more information regarding data handling and user privacy, please refer to the following:
    • Apple Pay Privacy Policy
    • Apple Pay Terms of Service
sections.faq:
How do I test this plugin?

You can enable the plugin’s test mode, which allows you to simulate transactions.

Does your plugin support WooCommerce Subscriptions?

No, our plugin currently does not support WooCommerce Subscriptions. While we understand the importance of this feature, it’s not currently part of our plugin’s functionality. We’re always working on improving our plugin and may consider adding support for WooCommerce Subscriptions in the future.

Where can I find documentation?

You can find our detailed documentation here.

Where can I get support or talk to other users?

If you get stuck, you can ask for help in the Plugin Forum.
